lines.text: Two runs left the same Alaska town, a century apart. The first went all the way. The second came home.
lines.t: Two runs left the same Alaska town, a century apart. The first went all the way. The second came home.

lines.text: January, 1925. Diphtheria threatened Nome.
lines.t: January, 1925. Diphtheria threatened Nome.

lines.text: Antitoxin came by train to Nenana, the railroad's closest point to Nome.
lines.t: Antitoxin came by train to Nenana, the railroad's closest point to Nome.

lines.text: Twenty mushers ran it by dog team, six hundred seventy four miles.
lines.t: Twenty mushers ran it by dog team, six hundred seventy four miles.

lines.text: Why not a plane? Nobody knew how a small engine would take forty below.

lines.text: August 19th. A drone takes off from Nenana.
lines.t: August 19th. A drone takes off from Nenana.

lines.text: A Windracers ULTRA.
lines.t: A Windracers ULTRA.

lines.text: Pilots at U A F's drone center fly it remotely.

lines.text: On board, human blood samples, for a sports anti doping agency.
lines.t: On board, human blood samples, for a sports anti doping agency.

lines.text: Each volunteer gave two samples. One flew. One stayed behind, to compare.
lines.t: Each volunteer gave two samples. One flew. One stayed behind, to compare.

lines.text: It stays up eight hours and forty seven minutes.
lines.t: It stays up eight hours and forty seven minutes.

lines.text: It covers a thousand kilometers, about six hundred twenty one miles. Nearly the length of the serum trail.
lines.t: It covers a thousand kilometers, about six hundred twenty one miles. Nearly the length of the serum trail.

lines.text: Then it lands where it started.
lines.t: Then it lands where it started.

lines.text: That forty below from 1925? U A F has flown small drones in it.
lines.t: That forty below from 1925? U A F has flown small drones in it.

lines.text: The center's director, Cathy Cahill, says this flight proves the blood could survive.
lines.t: The center's director, Cathy Cahill, says this flight proves the blood could survive.

lines.text: Here's the catch. No lab results have been published.

lines.text: Until they are, claim the trip, not the result.

lines.text: The state says eighty two percent of Alaska's communities are off the road system.

lines.text: A village run needs more than range. Federal rules regulate against flying beyond the operator's line of sight.

lines.text: U A F plans detect and avoid radar. Cahill calls it a key step toward medical delivery.

lines.text: If the drone ever loses link, Cahill says, the radar would let it automatically avoid other aircraft.
